dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: Unagi Fry Rice is the best. I ate it all! Not a single grain of rice was left behind, no sir!

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: Big Sister is very pretty when she laughs. She said that she'd never seen me eat that much, and that she'll make me more next time.

dialogues.speaker: Words on the Lamp
dialogues.text: I wish we could stay together forever.
